rationale: The implementation delta is the range and type used when parsing the numeric TPG identifier: the vulnerable version accepts values through UINT_MAX, while the fixed version parses a u16 and rejects identifiers at or above VHOST_SCSI_MAX_TARGET. The Logic section states only that the TPG name is validated, without specifying the accepted numeric range, type, or target-limit check. All other described operations—allocation, initialization, registration, cleanup on failures, and mutex-protected list insertion—occur in both versions.
